name: Quest
description: Actionable objectives, adventure hooks, and dilemmas

fields.description: Recover the unusual item known as {{ curio.name }} from the place described as {{ dungeon.name }} before someone with the {{ background:criminal.generator.name }} background claims it for a rival.
Track and capture or kill a creature of the {{ monster.name }} type, which witnesses recognize by the following unusual trait: {{ modifier_creature.name }}.
Defend the settlement known as {{ settlement.name }} against an attack, takeover, or coercive demand tied to {{ faction.name }}.
Escort someone with the {{ background.generator.name }} background through the region known as {{ region.name }} without revealing the true purpose of the journey.
Steal the valuable item known as {{ valuables.name }} from the building known as {{ building.name }} and return it to the person who can prove rightful ownership.
Find a missing person with the {{ background.generator.name }} background whose last confirmed destination was the place known as {{ dungeon.name }}.
Uncover and stop an operation involving the following criminal activity: {{ crime.name }}. The suspected organizer has the {{ background:criminal.generator.name }} background.
Prevent {{ faction.name }} and {{ faction.name }} from turning their dispute into open war around the settlement known as {{ settlement.name }}.
Negotiate a durable peace between a community from the people known in the region as “{{ race.name }}” and the inhabitants of the settlement called {{ settlement.name }}.
Deliver the valuable item known as {{ valuables.name }} to someone with the {{ background.generator.name }} background without revealing who commissioned the gift.
Establish first contact with a community from the people known in the region as “{{ race.name }}” and secure the basis for a lasting relationship.
Survey an unexplained phenomenon across the region known as {{ region.name }}, map its extent and changes, and report what can be learned about its cause.
Observe or capture a creature of the {{ monster.name }} type without killing it to understand its connection to the region known as {{ region.name }}.
Solve the murder of someone with the {{ background.generator.name }} background despite efforts by {{ faction.name }} to obstruct the investigation.
Observe someone with the {{ background.generator.name }} background during a secret meeting inside the building known as {{ building.name }} and learn what is being arranged.
Prevent the assassination of someone with the {{ background.generator.name }} background without exposing that the threat originates within {{ faction.name }}.
Gather enough of the material known as {{ material.name }} to prepare a remedy before the patient’s condition becomes irreversible.
Evacuate everyone endangered at the settlement known as {{ settlement.name }} before creatures of the following kind reach it and block the remaining safe routes: {{ monster.name }}.
Escape the place known as {{ dungeon.name }} with a captive who has the {{ background.generator.name }} background and refuses to explain the imprisonment.
Rescue a captive with the {{ background.generator.name }} background from someone with the {{ background:criminal.generator.name }} background inside the building known as {{ building.name }}.
Hide and protect the unusual item known as {{ curio.name }} from {{ faction.name }}, whose agents can magically or otherwise track the object and anyone who has handled it.
Prevent someone with the {{ background.generator.name }} background from discovering or revealing the location of the place known as {{ dungeon.name }}.
Follow someone with the {{ background.generator.name }} background through the settlement known as {{ settlement.name }} without alerting the target or their allies.
Collect the material known as {{ material.name }} in the region called {{ region.name }} before a seasonal change blocks access to the material or its source.
Deliver the valuable item known as {{ valuables.name }} to someone with the {{ background.generator.name }} background while rival claimants use matching seals and instructions to divert the parcel.
Locate and recover the valuable item known as {{ valuables.name }} from a cache hidden within a site described as {{ site.generator.name }}.
Find the knowledge, material, or aid needed to cure or break the affliction known as {{ affliction.name }}.
Determine whether this rumor is true and identify what supports or contradicts it: {{ rumor.description }}
Prevent the following secret from being discovered or revealed: {{ secret.description }}
Discover the truth behind the following secret and obtain evidence that can withstand scrutiny: {{ secret.description }}
Discover where the affliction known as {{ affliction.name }} first took hold and determine how to stop it from spreading or returning.
Recover an object bearing a rune of {{ rules.name }} from a site described as {{ site.generator.name }}.
Find and safely destroy an object bearing a rune of {{ rules.name }} hidden within a site described as {{ site.generator.name }}.
Disable an operation, device, route, or resource maintained by {{ faction.name }} at a site described as {{ site.generator.name }} without harming bystanders.
Restore a damaged structure, route, device, or resource on which the settlement known as {{ settlement.name }} depends.
Obtain protected records, correspondence, or plans kept inside the building known as {{ building.name }} without alerting their custodian.
Gather enough evidence to expose covert cooperation or wrongdoing involving {{ faction.name }} and a government following the {{ government.name }} model.

Resolve a debt or sworn obligation binding someone with the {{ background.generator.name }} background to {{ faction.name }} by fulfilling it, transferring it, collecting what is owed, or negotiating a release.
Protect a person, object, or vulnerable part of a site described as {{ site.generator.name }} while the following crisis unfolds: {{ event.description }}
Secure permission from {{ faction.name }} to enter, cross, inspect, or use a site described as {{ site.generator.name }}.
Hide and protect someone with the {{ background.generator.name }} background while {{ faction.name }} actively searches for them.
Provide work involving {{ service.name }} for a government following the {{ government.name }} model before a strict deadline while keeping the client’s involvement secret.
Find and secure evidence connecting {{ faction.name }} to the following criminal activity before the evidence is destroyed: {{ crime.name }}.
Negotiate and safeguard an exchange of captives between {{ faction.name }} and {{ faction.name }} before either side abandons the agreement.
